theorem_title: Scalar controls of a wanted record fit the wanted envelope
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.wanted_record_scalars_le {n K : ℕ} (hK : K≤_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.blocks n) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.blocks n+464*_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.half n+K+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BlockSourceEncoding.modulus (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.half n) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.blocks n)+
      _root_.ThreeSum.LightBlockQuery.sourceCut (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.half n) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.blocks n)+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localPrime (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.half n)+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localBucketCap (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.half n)+1024≤

theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $n,K\in\mathbb N$ with $K\le J$, where $h,J$ are the executable half-size and block count at size $n$. Write $m(h,J)$ for the global modulus, $c(h,J)$ for the source cutoff, $p_h$ for the local prime, and $b_h$ for its bucket cap. Then $$J+464h+K+m(h,J)+c(h,J)+p_h+b_h+1024\le\operatorname{wantedEnvelope}(n).$$

Collects the numeric controls passed to one physical wanted query. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
